headline: US threatens new tariffs on India and others as oil climbs and the rupee slips, while Andhra Pradesh votes in local elections.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh votes in local body and village elections
stories.summary: Polling is under way in 23 urban local bodies and 3,240 village councils in Andhra Pradesh. About 25 lakh voters can vote and counting is set for November 30.
stories.why_it_matters: These elections decide local governance in your home state.

stories.title: Rice prices nearly double in Nellore, officials tell traders to cap stocks
stories.summary: Sona Masoori rice has climbed to ₹100-120 a kg in Nellore district. Officials warned traders of legal action and stock seizure if they break the rules, and ordered them to display government-fixed maximum prices.
stories.why_it_matters: A staple food getting this expensive hits household budgets directly.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh to sell cheaper rice, tur dal and palm oil at 500 centres
stories.summary: CM Naidu ordered Dharani sales expanded to 500 centres. From the first week of December, tur dal will sell at ₹100 a kg and palm oil at ₹125 a litre at fair price shops.
stories.why_it_matters: It offers some relief as food prices rise.

stories.title: Tata Trusts to go to court against Chandrasekaran's reappointment
stories.summary: Tata Trusts decided to challenge N. Chandrasekaran's reappointment in the Bombay High Court. They call it illegal because it breaks the company's Articles of Association.
stories.why_it_matters: A fight at the top of one of India's biggest business groups could affect the company's leadership.

stories.title: US announces new tariffs on many countries including China and the EU
stories.summary: The US said new import taxes will hit many of its biggest trading partners, including China and the EU. Another report says the US proposed 25% tariffs on imports from India, which India rejected.
stories.why_it_matters: Tariffs can raise prices and hurt Indian exporters.

stories.title: UK-EU treaty text has a 10-year exit clause
stories.summary: The new UK-EU treaty can be ended after 10 years, the BBC understands. The full text and enabling legislation are due to be published.
stories.why_it_matters: It shapes trade and travel ties between Britain and Europe.

stories.title: Fuel tanker crash causes fire on Cairo highway, 31 dead
stories.summary: A tanker reportedly overturned on a busy ring road in Egypt's capital and caught fire. Thirty-one people died and 21 were injured.
stories.why_it_matters: It is one of the deadliest road disasters of the day.

stories.title: DR Congo Ebola cases pass 12,000
stories.summary: The country's worst Ebola outbreak is growing, and fighting in the east has displaced health workers and civilians. This makes it harder to contain.
stories.why_it_matters: Conflict hampering the response raises the risk of wider spread.

stories.title: Indian bonds fall as oil tops $95 and RBI flags food inflation
stories.summary: Brent crude rose above $95 a barrel, and RBI, India's central bank, warned of food price pressures. Investors are watching its policy decision on December 4, with a rate hike expected by some.
stories.why_it_matters: Higher interest rates would affect loan EMIs and fixed deposit rates.

stories.title: Rupee drops to 92.40 against the dollar
stories.summary: The rupee fell 20 paise on higher oil prices and the proposed US tariffs. India says it remains committed to finalising a trade deal.
stories.why_it_matters: A weaker rupee makes imports, fuel and foreign travel costlier.

stories.title: PF withdrawals via UPI likely by December-end
stories.summary: EPFO, which manages provident fund savings, is preparing to let members withdraw money through UPI. The minimum amount would be ₹1,000.
stories.why_it_matters: It could make getting your PF money faster and simpler.

stories.title: US regulator approves SpaceX plan for up to 1 million AI satellites
stories.summary: The FCC authorised SpaceX to launch up to 1 million satellites carrying AI chips under its Starmind plan. That would raise the number of satellites in orbit about 50-fold.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a big bet on moving AI computing into space.

stories.title: Nvidia reportedly halts chip shipments to Southeast Asia
stories.summary: The Financial Times reports Nvidia will not allow server makers to ship orders to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. A separate report says its top chips are reaching US firms owned by Chinese companies.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how tightly AI chip supply is being controlled and how export rules are being tested.

stories.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy ousted by Walmart
stories.summary: His decade-long run as head of the Flipkart group ended abruptly after parent Walmart asked him to go. The same roundup says PhonePe is reviving its IPO plans.
stories.why_it_matters: A leadership change at India's top e-commerce firm matters for the startup scene.
